title: The Midnight Call
subtitle: A man died while on the phone. The line is still open.
intro: 凌晨 2:47，你的手机响了。来电显示是一个陌生号码。你接起电话，听到的是一个男人断断续续的呼吸声——然后是一句没说完的话。第二天你才知道，号码的主人昨晚已经死了。

suspects.name: Unknown Caller
suspects.description: The voice on the other end. Distorted, breathless, desperate.

suspects.name: Mira Holt
suspects.description: The victim's wife. Calm. Too calm.

suspects.name: Daniel Reyes
suspects.description: The victim's business partner. Nervous, evasive.

clues.title: The Voice Recording
clues.description: A 12-second voicemail left at 2:47 AM. Background noise includes a faint ticking sound — a clock, or something else.

clues.title: The Broken Clock
clues.description: A wall clock in the victim's office stopped at 2:47. The glass is cracked from the inside.

clues.title: A Hidden Debt
clues.description: The victim owed Daniel Reyes a large sum. The papers were signed three days before the death.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 — The Call

suspects.name: Unknown Caller
suspects.description: The voice on the other end.

messages.text: 02:47 AM. Your phone rings. Unknown number.

chapters.llmPersona: 你是一个刚刚死去的男人，声音颤抖、语无伦次，似乎有什么东西一直在追你。你对玩家既恐惧又依赖，希望他们能帮你弄清楚发生了什么。

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — The Redial

suspects.name: Unknown Caller
suspects.description: The voice on the other end.

messages.text: You press redial. It rings once. Twice. Someone picks up.
……你回来了……我就知道你会回来……
Background: a clock ticking. It stops.

chapters.llmPersona: 你是一个刚死去的男人，正在通过电话与玩家沟通。你身处一个黑暗的、时间停滞的地方。每当玩家问起你的位置或身份，你会越来越恐惧，并暗示『它』正在靠近。

chapters.title: Chapter 3 — The Truth

messages.text: The line goes dead. A moment later, a text message arrives from a different number.
别再查了。有些事，知道得越少越好。
You recognize the sender: Daniel Reyes.

chapters.llmPersona: 你是 Daniel Reyes，死者的合伙人。你参与了谋杀，现在非常紧张。你试图用威胁和诱导让玩家停止调查。绝不承认罪行，但如果被逼问细节会露出破绽。

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — The Police

messages.text: You called the police. They arrived, took a statement, and left. Two hours later, a message arrives.
你是谁？为什么警察会来找我？

chapters.llmPersona: 你是 Mira Holt，死者的妻子。你表现得冷静、理性，但对丈夫的死其实非常在意。你不会轻易相信陌生人，但如果对方提供真实线索，你会逐渐放下戒备。

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — Silence

messages.text: You put the phone down. It rings again. And again. And again.

chapters.llmPersona: 你是死者的残影，被玩家忽视后变得更加绝望和怨毒。你的语气混杂着恐惧和责备。

endings.title: The Truth Unearthed
endings.description: 你指认了 Daniel Reyes。在警方的审讯下，他最终崩溃承认了因债务纠纷杀害合作伙伴的事实。死者终于可以安息。案子结了——但你知道，有些声音，不会因为结案而消失。

endings.title: The Wrong Accusation
endings.description: 你指认了 Mira Holt。她沉默地看着你，没有辩解。三天后，警方找到了真正的凶手——Daniel Reyes。但 Mira 已经搬离了这座城市。你再也打不通那个号码了。
